philosophy: Kare designed the original Macintosh icons and bitmap fonts (Chicago, Geneva, Monaco) on a strict pixel grid, often 32x32 in 1-bit black and white, treating each pixel as a deliberate decision. Her icons rely on instantly readable real-world metaphors (trash can, watch, Happy Mac) so meaning survives extreme constraint. The result is friendly, human, legible design where clarity beats ornament.
